In this petition, petitioner seeks for the following reliefs:-
"Wherefore, the Petitioner prays that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to allow the Petition and quash the entire proceedings in C.C.No.27029/2022( arising out of Crime No.343/2021) of Kamakshipalya Police Station for the alleged offence punishable under Section 498A of IPC and Section 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act pending on the file of Hon'ble XXXIX Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru City, in the interest of justice."
2.

entities.text: Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate at Bengaluru City
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned HCGP for 1st respondent and perused the material on record.
For the order proposed, notice to 2nd respondent is dispensed with.

3. A perusal of the material on record will indicate that respondent No.2-complainant filed a complaint before respondent No.1 police in Crime No.343/2021, which culminated in C.C.No.27029/2022 before the Trial Court for offences punishable NC: 2025:KHC:24575 HC-KAR under Section 498-A of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

Further, the matrimonial dispute filed by respondent No.2 against the petitioner-husband in M.C.No.3348/2023, ended up in settlement, wherein both parties settled the matrimonial dispute R. Chethan Alias Sunil vs The State Of Karnataka on 7 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117390912/
2 with mutual consent and further agreed to co-operate for quashing of C.C.No.27029/2022 pending before the Trial Court.

entities.text: R. Chethan Alias Sunil vs The State Of Karnataka
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The relevant portion of the said Memorandum of Settlement dated 26.03.2025 filed before the Family Court reads as under:
" 8.

In view of the settlement the respondent has agreed to withdraw/quash/ close the following cases as per the prevailing law of the land, they are:
a) The respondent has filed Crl.Misc.
No.573/2022 against the petitioner u/s 125 of Cr.P.C. for maintenance which is pending before the IV Addl.Family Court, Bengaluru.

b) The respondent has filed C.C.No.27029/2022 against the petitioner under section 498(A) of IPC and Section 3 & 4 of D.P.Act against the petitioner which is pending before the 24th ACMM, Bengaluru."
4.

In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances and the fact that the petitioner-accused and respondent No.2- complainant have settled the matrimonial dispute and also agreed NC:
2025:KHC:24575 HC-KAR to co-operate for quashing the criminal proceedings in C.C.No.27029/2022 pending before the Trial Court, continuation of criminal proceedings against the petitioner would amount to an abuse of process of law and the same deserves to be quashed.

5. In the result, I pass the following:
ORDER (i) Petition is hereby allowed.

(ii) The impugned criminal proceedings in C.C.No.27029/2022 (arising out of Crime No.343/2021 registered by respondent No.1-Police), offences punishable under Section 498-A of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the D.P.Act, pending on the file of XXXIX ACMM, Bengaluru, insofar as the petitioner is concerned, are hereby quashed.

Sd/-
(S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) JUDGE Srl.
